hero.intro: I design and build backend systems end-to-end — from architecture and implementation to deployment, reliability, and production operations. My focus is fintech, trading platforms, payment systems, and real-time distributed services.

about.heading: Building systems that hold under pressure
about.body1: My work is centered on backend systems that operate at scale — APIs handling high transaction volumes, distributed services processing real-time events, and fintech infrastructure where correctness is non-negotiable.
about.body2: I own the full lifecycle: system design, implementation, infrastructure, observability, and production operations. I work in .NET, Node.js, and Go, and I understand the tradeoffs that matter when building distributed systems in regulated, latency-sensitive environments.
about.body3: When the product demands it, I also deliver full-stack. But my strongest contribution is always at the system and backend layer — designing for reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

work.heading: Case Studies
work.subheading: A selection of systems I've designed, built, and operated in production.

projects.title: Self-Service Trading Platform
projects.problem: A fintech operator needed a scalable self-service platform handling live trading operations with MT5 integration, multi-provider payments, and KYC compliance flows — all with strict reliability requirements.
projects.built: Designed and implemented the backend architecture from scratch. Built trading execution services integrated with MetaTrader 5, payment provider connectors, and KYC verification pipelines. Implemented real-time event streams using Socket.IO and background job orchestration with RabbitMQ.
highlights: MT5 integration with order lifecycle management
Multi-provider payment routing with reconciliation
KYC flow orchestration with audit trail
Real-time account and position streaming via WebSocket
Containerised deployment with Docker and Kubernetes
projects.impact: Production system serving live trading operations. System architecture supports horizontal scaling and multi-region deployment readiness.

projects.title: Real-Time Telemetry & Fleet Tracking Backend
projects.problem: A fleet management product required a backend capable of ingesting binary telemetry from Teltonika GPS devices at high volume, processing location and route data in real time, and serving it to multiple client applications.
projects.built: Designed the telemetry ingestion pipeline including binary protocol parsing, geolocation processing, and route generation logic. Built distributed backend services with Go and Node.js, connected via RabbitMQ and gRPC for inter-service communication.
highlights: Binary Teltonika protocol parser
High-throughput telemetry ingestion pipeline
Real-time geolocation and route computation
gRPC-based inter-service communication
Redis-backed hot state for active vehicle tracking
projects.impact: Handled tracking for a growing fleet product serving enterprise customers. Sub-second latency for live vehicle position updates across connected clients.

projects.title: Payment & KYC Integration Layer
projects.problem: Financial products require reliable, auditable integrations with third-party payment providers and identity verification services. Integration failures or data inconsistencies in these flows carry direct financial and compliance risk.
projects.built: Built a modular payment integration layer with provider abstraction, idempotent transaction handling, and event-sourced audit trails. Implemented KYC orchestration with document verification workflows and compliance state machines.
highlights: Provider-agnostic payment abstraction layer
Idempotent transaction processing
Webhook ingestion with at-least-once delivery guarantees
KYC state machine with document lifecycle management
Full audit log for regulatory traceability
projects.impact: Enabled the platform to onboard multiple payment providers and KYC vendors without core service changes. Zero unrecovered transaction failures in production.

projects.title: Serverless API Platform
projects.problem: A product team needed a cost-efficient, low-operational-overhead backend API that could scale automatically and integrate tightly with AWS managed services.
projects.built: Contributed to a serverless backend using AWS Lambda with API Gateway, DynamoDB for primary storage, and event-driven architecture for async processing. Focused on function design, cold start optimization, and service integration patterns.
highlights: Lambda function design with cold-start mitigation
DynamoDB access patterns and single-table design
API Gateway integration with request validation
Event-driven async processing
Infrastructure-as-code deployment
projects.impact: Production API serving customer-facing product features. Reduced operational overhead compared to managed VM deployments with pay-per-use scaling.
